uid.description: The unique identifier of the entity.
uid.caption: Unique ID

sensor_layer.description: The technology or sensor layer that emitted the data, normalized to the caption of sensor_layer_id. When sensor_layer_id is 99 (Other), this attribute must contain the source-specific label.
sensor_layer.caption: Sensor Layer

3.description: The analyzed data is emitted by, or originates from an email gateway or email security system.
3.caption: Email

6.description: The analyzed data is emitted by, or originates from a cyber threat intelligence (CTI) system or by matching observables against a threat intelligence feed or report.
6.caption: Threat Intel

0.description: The sensor layer type is Unknown.
0.caption: Unknown

1.description: The analyzed data is emitted by, or originates from a network, firewall, or IPS sensor.
1.caption: Network

2.description: The analyzed data is emitted by, or originates from an endpoint device or agent running on an OS.
2.caption: Endpoint

99.description: The sensor layer type is not mapped. See the sensor_layer attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
99.caption: Other

4.description: The analyzed data is emitted by, or originates from an identity and access management (IAM) system or service.
4.caption: IAM

5.description: The analyzed data is emitted by, or originates from a proxy server (e.g., forward or reverse proxy, web gateway).
5.caption: Proxy

7.description: The analyzed data is emitted by, or originates from an application (e.g., web application, SaaS platform, or custom business application).
7.caption: Application

sensor_layer_id.description: The normalized identifier of the sensor layer that emitted the data. For example, use this to classify the detection surface (e.g., IPS sensor, endpoint agent, email gateway). When the type is not listed, use 99 (Other) and populate sensor_layer with the source-specific label.
sensor_layer_id.caption: Sensor Layer ID

uid_numeric.description:
The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.
Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it.
uid_numeric.caption: Numeric Unique ID

name: sensor_info
description: The Sensor Information object describes a control point sensor that emits data, or originates detections. It can be part of an endpoint or agent running on an OS, a SaaS application, a network device, a Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) system, or other detection and enforcement technologies.
caption: Sensor Information
